core_problem_solved: To provide the official client library for Java applications to connect to, read from, and write to a remote Apache HBase cluster.
key_features: Provides the client-side API for all HBase data operations (Get, Put, Scan, Delete)
Manages connections to the cluster, including locating regions
Abstracts the complexity of the underlying RPC communication with HBase servers
era_and_niche: The standard and essential client dependency for any modern Java application that interacts with Apache HBase. It is a core component of the Hadoop and big data ecosystem.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete**. It is the current, actively maintained client for HBase and is the direct successor to the client functionality that was previously bundled in the monolithic `org.apache.hbase:hbase` artifact.
